cd /tmp && mkdir -p eval_test && cd eval_test && cat > outputs.json << 'EOF'
["Hello", "World", "Test"]
EOF
cat > references.json << 'EOF'
["hello", "world", "test"]
EOF
cat outputs.json && echo "---" && cat references.json

cat > test_comprehensive.sh << 'TESTEOF'
#!/bin/bash

echo "=== Test 1: No thresholds (should exit 0) ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs test_eval/outputs.json --references test_eval/references.json >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "Exit code: $?"

echo ""
echo "=== Test 2: Passing threshold (should exit 0) ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs test_eval/outputs.json --references test_eval/references.json --threshold exact_match=0.5 >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "Exit code: $?"

echo ""
echo "=== Test 3: Failing threshold (should exit 1) ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs test_eval/outputs.json --references test_eval/references.json --threshold exact_match=0.9 >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "Exit code: $?"

echo ""
echo "=== Test 4: Multiple thresholds, all passing (should exit 0) ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs test_eval/outputs.json --references test_eval/references.json --threshold exact_match=0.5 --threshold length_variance=0.5 >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "Exit code: $?"

echo ""
echo "=== Test 5: Multiple thresholds, one failing (should exit 1) ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs test_eval/outputs.json --references test_eval/references.json --threshold exact_match=0.9 --threshold length_variance=0.5 >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "Exit code: $?"

echo ""
echo "=== Test 6: Invalid threshold value (should exit 2) ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs test_eval/outputs.json --references test_eval/references.json --threshold exact_match=1.5 >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "Exit code: $?"

echo ""
echo "=== Test 7: Unknown metric (should exit 2) ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs test_eval/outputs.json --references test_eval/references.json --threshold unknown=0.5 >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "Exit code: $?"

echo ""
echo "=== Test 8: Invalid format (should exit 2) ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs test_eval/outputs.json --references test_eval/references.json --threshold "not-valid" >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "Exit code: $?"

echo ""
echo "=== Test 9: Metric with no score fails threshold (should exit 1) ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs test_eval/outputs.json --references test_eval/references_empty.json --threshold exact_match=0.0001 >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "Exit code: $?"
TESTEOF
chmod +x test_comprehensive.sh
./test_comprehensive.sh

git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add --threshold option to frai eval for CI gating

Add optional --threshold <metric>=<min> option to the frai eval command, which can be used multiple times to gate CI pipelines on metric scores. The feature works for both built-in and custom metrics.

- Exit 0 if all thresholds pass, 1 if any fail, 2 for usage errors
- JSON reports gain 'passed' and 'thresholds' fields
- Markdown reports gain a 'Thresholds' section with PASS/FAIL status
- Metrics with no score fail their threshold instead of crashing
- Valid metrics: exact_match, toxicity, length_variance
- Implemented in frai-core generateReport and frai-cli parseThresholds
- Updated documentation and added tests for threshold functionality
EOF
)"

git add docs/eval_harness_design.md packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts packages/frai-core/README.md packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js

     - Pass them to `generateReport()`
     - Exit with code 0 if all pass, 1 if any fail, 2 for usage errors
   - Added proper error messages for invalid thresholds

   - Updated `README.md` with threshold option documentation
   - Added section to `docs/eval_harness_design.md` documenting the threshold feature

- ✅ Failing threshold: exits 1
- ✅ Invalid threshold value: exits 2 with error message
